text: Thank you so much for giving me the opportunity to help. Oh, hey, Penny, this is Alicia, our new neighbor. I'm helping.

text: Alicia's non-musical, childless, and pro-rogue. She's still on probation, of course, but I like her.

text: Cool t-shirt. Oh, yeah, I don't usually dress like this. I'm going jogging. I can start.

text: True, but the more likely explanation for your attire is that you're out of clean clothes again. You're welcome, Penny.

speaker: Penny
text: Ladies, you look cute. I'm dressed like a slob today, too.

speaker: Penny
text: This one's a flare, huh? Oh, yeah, be careful. Thanks for the warning. I'll see you around. Yeah. Shut up.

text: I enjoy mimicry. I've been working on Admiral Ackbar from Return of the Jedi. It's a trap!
